title: Energy and force prediction on a fixed Au-Ti-O reference dataset
domain: Computational chemistry and machine-learned interatomic potentials

task_sources.name: Task design and contributor-supplied pre-existing Au-Ti-O reference data described in approved Proposal #22

metric.description: Primary raw score is element-balanced force RMSE: sqrt((MSE_Au+MSE_O+MSE_Ti)/3) in unchanged source force units; lower is better. Energy RMSE is diagnostic only. Display conversion is not yet classified.
